title: Device Status Payload v1
description: payload for an envelope with eventType='device-status', schemaVersion=1. Device lifecycle / health transitions, including the fleet-health monitor's 'went silent' signal.

reason.description: Human-readable context for the transition (e.g. 'no telemetry for 5m', 'disabled by operator').

lastSeenAt.description: When telemetry was last received from this device, if known.
